title: Louis Dumaine's band and the Victor records
summary: Asked about Louis Dumaine's records, he says another banjoist, Leonard, played in his place on the Victor sides, and he stayed in the band afterwards.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I was going to ask some more about Louis Dumaine band. Did you make any records with Louis Dumaine when he made those? Well, I did. He made some for Victor once.

I didn't have a chance to make no records with the boys. But, uh, they had made records. And, uh, time the fellas, no fella come, I don't know if he come out of New York or way. But he had come from, from up to nine, you see. And, uh, a little fella called Leonard, he had played in my place, you see, made the records. But after that, I stood in the band with him. And we played, uh, I went to a dance hall.
